record.scopeText: All 7186 safe, non-partial public survey mathematical declarations and their complete transitive mathematical dependency closure, including private helpers and required external mathematical libraries, rechecked in an empty kernel environment. Six compiler-generated unsafe/partial implementation declarations are excluded from replay roots; every dependency reached by a mathematical root is checked and any unsafe/partial dependency is rejected. The separate axiom audit includes all 7192 survey declarations.
record.limits: Five selected problems are covered. The pipeline examples and every intermediate manuscript argument are not separately certified.
record.correspondence: This is one of the five selected problems proved by the SurveyStatements project. The complete mathematical dependency closure is covered by the saved replay. The examples in the automated-pipeline part of the survey are outside these five certificates.
